epic.summary: Week 3: Procedural/Episodic Memory + Prompt Version Management
epic.description: Complete CoALA four-layer memory (Procedural + Episodic deferred from Week 2), implement prompt version registry with cache invalidation on version bumps, and wire cross-layer memory retrieval into Focus agent.
dependencies: Working + Semantic memory operational (pgvector on Supabase)

decisions.scope: Procedural + Episodic memory Days 1-2, prompt version registry Day 3, integration Day 4, validation Day 5
decisions.version_source: CONTRACT.md per agent directory under prompts/

tasks.description: Implement CoALA procedural memory layer — JSON skill definitions with access control, Alembic migration, ProceduralMemoryStore with progressive disclosure.
acceptance_criteria: backend/memory/procedural.py implements ProceduralMemoryStore
Alembic migration 003 creates procedural_memory table with RLS
Skills filterable by agent_id and allowed_agents access control
Tests in backend/tests/memory/test_procedural.py pass

tasks.description: Implement episodic memory for distilled session lessons (not raw logs), session isolation, versioning with supersede support, and working memory distillation in consolidation.py.
acceptance_criteria: backend/memory/episodic.py implements EpisodicMemoryStore
Alembic migration 004 creates episodic_memory table with RLS
consolidate_session_memory distills working snippets to episodic lessons
Session isolation enforced via user_id + session_id
Tests in backend/tests/memory/test_episodic.py pass

tasks.summary: Day 3: Prompt Version Registry + Cache Invalidation
tasks.description: Central prompt version registry reading CONTRACT.md per agent, resolve_prompt_version() for all agents, detect version changes and log cache invalidation events.
acceptance_criteria: backend/prompt_version.py parses CONTRACT.md versions
All LLM agents use resolve_prompt_version() in ExecutionMetadata
Version change detection logs prompt_cache_version_changed
Tests in backend/tests/test_prompt_version.py pass

tasks.description: Wire procedural and episodic retrieval into retrieval.py and Focus agent; implement semantic memory consolidation (age-based prune).
acceptance_criteria: retrieve_agent_memory() returns semantic + procedural + episodic context
Focus agent payload includes procedural_skills and episodic_lessons
consolidate_semantic_memory prunes rows older than max_age_days
Memory audit trail covers procedural and episodic layers

tasks.summary: Day 5: Integration Tests, Proof Package & Documentation
tasks.description: 15+ cross-layer integration scenarios, proof/week3/, docs/learning/week3-memory-and-versioning.md, update ARCHITECTURE.md.
acceptance_criteria: 10+ new integration test scenarios pass
proof/week3/ captures test output and git history
docs/learning/week3-memory-and-versioning.md complete
All four CoALA memory layers documented in ARCHITECTURE.md
